# Repository instructions

## Tag: Task workflow (`workflow`)

Read and follow `instructions.md` and `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.
Use the relevant project skill under `.agents/skills/`. Project-owned classes
use the `CYL` prefix, and new UIKit category selectors use `cyl_`. Preserve
required third-party copyright and license notices.

Rules are grouped by tag in `instructions.md` and `AGENTS.md`; full texts in `docs/instructions/<tag>.md`.
